family_acceptance.canonicalization: alpha-normalized identifiers; all literal values removed; operation kind/order/variant and output type retained
family_acceptance.cross_split_checks: all exact and near-duplicate checks use the union of earlier accepted splits
family_acceptance.near_duplicate_rule: reject when same output type and operation-token multiset Jaccard >=0.90 and ordered operation-token similarity >=0.90
family_acceptance.numeric_near_duplicate_rule: input-only similarity never creates a new family; skeleton uniqueness is mandatory regardless of numeric distance
family_acceptance.prior_content_overlap: reject exact source, prompt, or canonical skeleton hashes found in tracked prior project artifacts or excluded fixtures

generation_contract.router_rng: feature transform and policy selection consume no sampling RNG

population.estimand: utility over independently generated families from this frozen restricted-Python generator law
population.family: one normalized source-program skeleton with one allocated typed input

input_law.text: uniform over the frozen eight-token vocabulary

population.nested_not_independent: additional inputs, renamed variables, formatting changes, and literal-only changes to one skeleton
population.operation_fill: required archetype operations plus uniform deterministic draws from eight operation kinds

qualification.conditions: exact eight bank policies, external champion, online routed system
qualification.oracle_headroom: mean over 300 families of max across bank policies of two-rollout mean correctness minus champion two-rollout mean correctness
qualification.pooled_row_aggregation: validity/evaluability/repetition rates pool 600 rows per condition
qualification.sharing_rationale: qualification conditions retain distinct frozen seeds and independently exercise the online routed engine; no post-hoc reuse

reference_contract.path_a: direct IR interpreter; never compiles source
reference_contract.path_b: isolated pinned CPython -I -S worker after independent AST whitelist validation
reference_contract.typed_serialization: Python repr for int/bool/str/list/tuple/string-keyed dict; exact ast.literal_eval roundtrip

worker.filesystem: empty non-writable cwd plus audit hook
worker.network: blocked by absence of allowed import/attribute nodes plus audit hook
worker.resource_policy: CPU/file/fd rlimits; Linux AS cap; macOS 2ms fail-closed RSS watchdog

productions: integer arithmetic with Python floor/modulo semantics
list aliasing and bounded indexed mutation
bounded digit recursion represented by a depth-limited while production

seed_derivation.formula: first 63 bits of SHA256('Q3-FRESH-V1' || prelock_file_sha256 || containing_commit || namespace)
seed_derivation.when: only after the containing prelock commit is published
